name: ct-security-mcp
description: CrowdStrike Falcon (Commercial and GovCloud) and Tenable Vulnerability Management MCP servers for the State of Connecticut security team.

falcon_commercial_client_id.title: Falcon Commercial API Client ID
falcon_commercial_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID for a Falcon API client on the Commercial CID, read-only recommended.

falcon_commercial_client_secret.title: Falcon Commercial API Client Secret
falcon_commercial_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with the Commercial client ID above.

falcon_gov_client_id.title: Falcon GovCloud API Client ID
falcon_gov_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID for a Falcon API client on the GovCloud CID, read-only recommended.

falcon_gov_client_secret.title: Falcon GovCloud API Client Secret
falcon_gov_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with the GovCloud client ID above.

tenable_access_key.title: Tenable API Access Key
tenable_access_key.description: Access Key from Settings > My Account > API Keys in Tenable Vulnerability Management.

tenable_secret_key.title: Tenable API Secret Key
tenable_secret_key.description: Secret Key paired with the Access Key above.
